label: Engraving
description: Black-and-white line engraving with dramatic light, in the tradition of nineteenth-century illustrated Bibles.
rendering: A finished black-and-white wood engraving of the work's world: fine parallel and cross-hatched lines model form and light, with deep blacks and luminous whites.
palette: Black ink on white only; tones made by line density, no color.
lighting: Dramatic, theatrical light with strong contrast between shadow and radiance.
materials: Crisp engraved line work within the depicted world; skies and ground fully hatched.
composition: Grand, cinematic staging with deep space; hatching and tone carried to every edge and corner.
negatives: The engraved scene fills the whole image: no white plate margin, border line or frame, and no caption, title, signature or plate number. Avoid color, photorealism and cartoon caricature.
